study_identification_part.si4_title: Developmental trajectories of neuroanatomical alterations associated with the 16p11.2 Copy Number Variations

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study objectives are clearly stated: to characterize age-related effects of 16p11.2 CNVs on brain growth using a normative developmental dataset.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we aim at characterizing age-related effects of 16p11.2 copy number variants by analyzing a group with a broad age range including younger individuals. A large normative developmental dataset was used to accurately adjust for effects of age.
